newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 24.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 24. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto returns from his state visit to Cambodia, Laos and Burma which aimed as strengthening Indonesia's relations with the three countries. Suharto said he was satisfied with the visit.

The Moslem-based United Development Party (PPP) asked ulemas from the three political parties to convene before the May 29 general elections to reach a consensus. The other parties are the ruling Golkar and the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI).
The Indonesian-made N-2130 jetliner is expected to enter the market in 2004. The aircraft will be produced by the state-owned Industri Pesawat Terbang Nusantara (IPTN) aircraft maker.
Indonesia's Bank Bira has been voted as the best domestic investment bank in Asia-Pacific by the Finance Asia magazine.
